newsitem.title: CHINA: FORECAST-China GDP to grow 7.5 pct/yr 2000-2010.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-China GDP to grow 7.5 pct/yr 2000-2010.

text.p: China's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is expected to grow an average of at least 7.5 percent annually between 2000 and 2010, the China Business Daily said on Friday, quoting the State Statistical Bureau.

Industrial output was forecast to grow an average of more than nine percent a year between 2000 and 2010, the newspaper said. Industrial output has climbed an average of 12.2 percent in the past 15 years.
Agricultural output would inch up an average of three percent per year in the next 15 years compared with 5.4 percent in the past 15 years, it said.
Grain output increased an average of 2.5 percent a year during the period, the newspaper said. It gave no further details.
